summary: Yimutian Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing an ADS ratio change from 1:25 to 1:375, effective May 18, 2026, which functions like a 15-for-1 reverse split. JPMorgan Chase Bank, as depositary, will handle the exchange. No ordinary shares are issued or cancelled. The change aims to increase ADS trading price but carries no guarantee. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special situation; it is a routine corporate action to adjust ADS price levels.
